title: Consent Capture and Management
description: Data Fiduciary must obtain free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous consent from the Data Principal before processing personal data. Consent must be given through an affirmative action and the request must be presented clearly and plainly in simple language.

actions.title: Implement consent capture interface
actions.description: Deploy a mechanism that captures explicit, informed consent before any personal data collection. Must present purpose clearly and record timestamp.

actions.title: Implement consent versioning and audit trail
actions.description: Maintain a versioned history of all consents given, withdrawn or modified by each Data Principal with timestamps.

actions.title: Deploy consent storage and retrieval system
actions.description: Build or configure a system to store consent records and retrieve them for regulatory audits.

title: Privacy Notice Implementation
description: Before collecting personal data, the Data Fiduciary must provide a clear notice describing what data is collected, the purpose of processing, how to exercise rights, and how to contact the grievance officer.

actions.title: Draft and publish compliant privacy notice
actions.description: Create a privacy notice in plain language covering data categories, processing purposes, retention period, and Data Principal rights.

actions.title: Implement notice update notification system
actions.description: Build a mechanism to inform Data Principals whenever the privacy notice is materially updated.

title: Consent Withdrawal Mechanism
description: Data Fiduciary must provide a simple and accessible mechanism for Data Principals to withdraw consent at any time. Withdrawal must be as easy as giving consent.

actions.title: Build self-service consent withdrawal portal
actions.description: Provide an easily accessible interface for users to view and withdraw specific or all consents without contacting support.

actions.title: Automate post-withdrawal processing stop
actions.description: Ensure that withdrawal of consent automatically triggers cessation of the relevant data processing activities within specified timeframe.

title: Legitimate Use Documentation
description: Where processing is based on legitimate use (without consent) under Section 7, the Data Fiduciary must document and maintain records of the specific legitimate purpose relied upon.

actions.title: Create legitimate use register
actions.description: Document all processing activities that rely on legitimate use, specifying which Section 7 ground applies and why.

title: Purpose Limitation Controls
description: Personal data must be processed only for the specific purpose for which it was collected. The Data Fiduciary must implement technical and organizational controls to prevent data from being used for other purposes.

actions.title: Define and document all processing purposes
actions.description: Create a formal register of all purposes for which personal data is processed across all systems.

actions.title: Implement technical purpose limitation controls
actions.description: Configure database access controls and application logic to enforce purpose limitations at the technical level.

title: Data Minimization Policy
description: Data Fiduciary shall collect only the personal data that is necessary for the specified purpose. Excessive or irrelevant data collection is prohibited.

actions.title: Conduct data inventory and classification
actions.description: Identify all personal data collected across systems, classify by sensitivity and assess whether collection is truly necessary.

actions.title: Implement data collection restrictions
actions.description: Configure forms, APIs and systems to collect only required fields and block unnecessary data collection.

title: Data Accuracy Maintenance
description: Data Fiduciary must take reasonable steps to ensure personal data is accurate and up to date. Inaccurate data that could cause harm to the Data Principal must be corrected.

actions.title: Implement data quality monitoring
actions.description: Set up automated checks to detect and flag inaccurate or outdated personal data across all systems.

actions.title: Build data correction workflow
actions.description: Create a process for Data Principals and internal teams to flag and correct inaccurate data with audit trail.

title: Data Retention and Deletion Policy
description: Personal data must not be retained longer than necessary for the specified purpose. Data Fiduciary must define retention schedules and implement automated deletion when retention period expires.

actions.title: Define retention schedules for all data categories
actions.description: Create a data retention matrix specifying how long each category of personal data is kept and the legal basis for the period.

actions.title: Automate data deletion at retention expiry
actions.description: Configure systems to automatically purge personal data when retention period expires, with deletion certificates.

title: Security Safeguards for Personal Data
description: Data Fiduciary must implement appropriate technical and organisational security safeguards to protect personal data from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration or destruction.

actions.title: Implement encryption at rest and in transit
actions.description: Encrypt all personal data stored in databases and all transmissions over networks using industry-standard algorithms.

actions.title: Deploy access control and authentication
actions.description: Implement role-based access control, MFA, and principle of least privilege for all systems holding personal data.

actions.title: Conduct vulnerability assessment and penetration testing
actions.description: Perform regular security assessments to identify and remediate vulnerabilities in systems processing personal data.

title: Data Breach Detection System
description: Data Fiduciary must implement monitoring systems capable of detecting personal data breaches in a timely manner to enable prompt notification to the Data Protection Board and affected Data Principals.

actions.title: Deploy SIEM solution for threat monitoring
actions.description: Implement a Security Information and Event Management system to detect anomalous access patterns and potential data breaches in real time.

actions.title: Implement Data Loss Prevention solution
actions.description: Deploy DLP tools to detect and prevent unauthorized exfiltration of personal data from the organization.

title: Data Breach Notification Process
description: Upon becoming aware of a personal data breach, the Data Fiduciary must notify the Data Protection Board and affected Data Principals in the manner and within the time prescribed.

actions.title: Define breach notification SOP
actions.description: Create a documented Standard Operating Procedure for identifying, assessing, and notifying breaches including internal escalation paths and timelines.

actions.title: Set up Data Protection Board notification mechanism
actions.description: Configure the workflow and templates to notify the Data Protection Board within the prescribed timeline after detecting a breach.

actions.title: Configure Data Principal breach notification
actions.description: Build automated notification system to inform affected Data Principals about the nature of breach and remediation steps taken.

title: Children Data Age Verification
description: Before processing personal data of a child, the Data Fiduciary must verify the age of the Data Principal and obtain verifiable parental consent for any child under 18 years of age.

actions.title: Implement age verification mechanism
actions.description: Deploy a reliable age verification system that confirms users are above 18 or triggers parental consent flow for minors.

actions.title: Build verifiable parental consent workflow
actions.description: Create a process to obtain verifiable consent from the parent or legal guardian before processing a child's personal data.

title: Children Data Processing Restrictions
description: Data Fiduciary must not process personal data of children in a manner that is detrimental to their well-being, must not undertake tracking or behavioral monitoring of children.

actions.title: Block behavioral tracking for minor accounts
actions.description: Configure analytics and advertising tools to disable behavioral profiling and targeted advertising for users identified as minors.

actions.title: Implement child-safe content and data controls
actions.description: Configure content filtering and data access restrictions to ensure children's data is not used for potentially harmful purposes.

title: Right of Access Implementation
description: Data Fiduciary must provide Data Principals with a mechanism to obtain a summary of personal data being processed and identities of all Data Fiduciaries with whom data has been shared.

actions.title: Build data access request portal
actions.description: Create a self-service portal where Data Principals can request a copy of all personal data held about them.

actions.title: Automate data retrieval across systems
actions.description: Configure automated data discovery and compilation to fulfil access requests within the prescribed time limit.

title: Right to Correction and Erasure
description: Data Fiduciary must implement mechanisms allowing Data Principals to request correction, completion, updating or erasure of their personal data.

actions.title: Implement correction and erasure request workflow
actions.description: Build a structured workflow for Data Principals to submit correction/erasure requests with identity verification.

actions.title: Automate erasure across all data stores
actions.description: Configure automated deletion workflows that propagate erasure requests across all systems, databases and backups.

actions.title: Generate deletion certificates
actions.description: Issue verifiable certificates confirming data has been permanently erased from all systems upon request completion.

title: Grievance Redressal Mechanism
description: Data Fiduciary must establish an effective mechanism for Data Principals to submit grievances, and address such grievances within the prescribed timeline.

actions.title: Set up grievance submission portal
actions.description: Create an accessible portal for Data Principals to submit privacy-related grievances with tracking and acknowledgment.

actions.title: Define grievance resolution SLA and escalation
actions.description: Document and implement timelines and escalation paths ensuring grievances are resolved within the prescribed period.

title: Data Principal Nomination Feature
description: Data Fiduciary must provide a mechanism for Data Principals to nominate another individual to exercise their rights in the event of death or incapacity.

actions.title: Implement nomination registration interface
actions.description: Build a feature allowing Data Principals to designate a nominee with identity verification and consent from the nominee.

actions.title: Build nominee rights exercise workflow
actions.description: Create a process for nominees to prove their nomination and exercise the Data Principal's rights after verification.

title: Vendor and Processor Data Processing Agreements
description: Data Fiduciary must ensure that any Data Processor engaged to process personal data on its behalf does so only on documented instructions and provides sufficient guarantees of compliance.

actions.title: Create standard Data Processing Agreement template
actions.description: Draft a DPA template covering processing instructions, sub-processors, security obligations and breach notification.

actions.title: Conduct vendor privacy risk assessment
actions.description: Assess all vendors processing personal data against a defined risk framework and document assessment outcomes.

actions.title: Maintain vendor processing register
actions.description: Keep an up-to-date register of all vendors with access to personal data, their processing activities, and DPA status.

title: Data Inventory and Records of Processing Activities
description: Data Fiduciary must maintain comprehensive Records of Processing Activities (ROPA) documenting all personal data processing operations including categories, purposes, recipients and retention periods.

actions.title: Create comprehensive ROPA
actions.description: Document all processing activities in a Records of Processing Activities register covering data categories, purposes, legal basis, retention and recipients.

actions.title: Automate data discovery and mapping
actions.description: Use automated tools to discover personal data across all systems and generate data flow diagrams.

title: Employee Data Protection Training
description: Data Fiduciary must ensure all employees who handle personal data receive regular training on data protection obligations, policies and procedures.

actions.title: Conduct mandatory data protection awareness training
actions.description: Deliver and track completion of annual data protection training for all staff handling personal data.

actions.title: Role-specific privacy training for high-risk roles
actions.description: Provide specialized training for roles with elevated access to personal data such as developers, data analysts and customer support.

title: Privacy by Design Implementation
description: Data Fiduciary must integrate privacy considerations into the design of systems and processes from inception rather than as an afterthought.

actions.title: Integrate privacy impact assessment into development lifecycle
actions.description: Mandate and conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments for all new systems or significant changes that process personal data.

actions.title: Implement privacy-preserving technical controls
actions.description: Deploy data masking, pseudonymization or anonymization where full personal data is not required for the processing purpose.

title: Security Incident Response Plan
description: Data Fiduciary must have a documented and tested incident response plan that enables rapid containment and investigation of security incidents involving personal data.

actions.title: Define and document incident response playbooks
actions.description: Create detailed runbooks for different incident types covering detection, containment, eradication, recovery and post-incident review.

actions.title: Conduct incident response tabletop exercises
actions.description: Run regular simulated breach scenarios with relevant stakeholders to test and improve the incident response plan.

title: Cookie and Tracking Consent Management
description: Data Fiduciary operating digital platforms must obtain specific consent for cookies and tracking technologies before placing them on user devices, in line with the consent requirements of the Act.

actions.title: Deploy compliant cookie consent banner
actions.description: Implement a cookie consent management platform that provides granular control and records consent per category.

actions.title: Conduct cookie audit and categorization
actions.description: Scan all websites and apps to identify cookies and trackers, categorize them by purpose and update the cookie notice accordingly.

title: Third-Party App and Integration Governance
description: Data Fiduciary must assess and govern all third-party integrations and applications that are granted access to personal data.

actions.title: Implement app permission review and approval process
actions.description: Establish a formal approval process for any third-party application requesting access to systems or data containing personal data.

actions.title: Conduct third-party security assessments
actions.description: Regularly assess the security posture of third-party vendors with access to personal data.

title: Privacy Accountability and Governance Framework
description: Data Fiduciary must establish organizational accountability for data protection including appointing responsible personnel and implementing governance processes.

actions.title: Appoint and empower privacy point of contact
actions.description: Designate a responsible individual or team for data protection compliance and provide them adequate authority and resources.

actions.title: Implement privacy governance policies
actions.description: Create, approve and publish internal data protection policies covering all key processing activities.

title: Data Protection Impact Assessment (SDF)
description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must conduct a Data Protection Impact Assessment for each new or significantly changed high-risk processing activity before commencement.

actions.title: Develop DPIA methodology and templates
actions.description: Create a standardized DPIA process with risk assessment templates aligned to the DPDP Act requirements.

actions.title: Maintain DPIA register and outcomes
actions.description: Document all DPIAs conducted, their findings, risk mitigations implemented and residual risks accepted.

title: Periodic Compliance Audit (SDF)
description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must conduct periodic audits of compliance with the DPDP Act and rules made thereunder, conducted by an independent data auditor.

actions.title: Engage independent data auditor
actions.description: Appoint a qualified independent auditor to conduct annual data protection compliance audit.

actions.title: Implement audit findings remediation tracking
actions.description: Track and remediate all findings from the data audit with defined owners, timelines and evidence of completion.

title: Data Protection Officer Appointment (SDF)
description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must appoint a Data Protection Officer who is a key managerial person and serves as the point of contact for the Data Protection Board.

actions.title: Formally appoint and register DPO
actions.description: Appoint a qualified DPO, document their mandate, authority, and register them with the Data Protection Board.

actions.title: Set up DPO task management and reporting system
actions.description: Provide the DPO with tools to track compliance tasks, manage requests and report to senior management.

title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Compliance (SDF)
description: Significant Data Fiduciaries must comply with restrictions on transfer of personal data outside India as prescribed by the Central Government.

actions.title: Map all cross-border data flows
actions.description: Identify and document all personal data transfers outside India, including cloud services, vendors and group entities.

actions.title: Implement data localization for restricted categories
actions.description: Configure cloud infrastructure and data stores to keep personal data of Indian citizens within India where required.

title: Algorithmic Transparency and Explainability (SDF)
description: Significant Data Fiduciaries using automated decision-making systems must ensure transparency and provide explanations to Data Principals for decisions affecting them.

actions.title: Audit automated decision-making systems
actions.description: Identify and assess all systems making automated decisions about individuals and document their logic and impact.

actions.title: Implement explainability for automated decisions
actions.description: Build mechanisms to provide Data Principals with meaningful explanations when automated decisions significantly affect them.
